flowchart LR
  Registry["registry.json + claim-reviews.json"] --> ResearchBuild["research-ledger/build.py"]
  Master["canonical master TeX"] --> PaperAudit["paper-ledger audit"]
  Ledger["paper ledger bindings"] --> PaperAudit
